speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The parish clerk was here before you, with a paper from Crosby Place. Master Thwaite is to read it on Sunday next. No blue starch in ruffs. I had it by heart before the spoons were down.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You have the Mayor's mind in the house before the pottage. Has he found the root of the dearth, and is it in our collars?

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Starch is good wheat boiled to vanity, and blue is vanity dyed.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Mistress.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Sit, and eat. The loaf is a finger and a half short of the notch, and it is a penny. I will hear the colour after the bread.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A finger and a half, and a war on collars. I am asking whether that is the root.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You may laugh. He is a hard man and he is right about ruffs.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I have one band. It was starched blue. I bought it at Whitsun last. It is upstairs.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: One band. That is the offender, if an offender can be a band in a box.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Do not make a play of her. Alse, you have sat still since the clerk's name. Say what you want said.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I do not want to wear it if the paper says no. I only did not want to speak first.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then you may wash it white. Wash it before Sunday. White is what the paper will bear, and I am of the Mayor's mind on this and not on his dinner.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will wash it. Thank you, mistress.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Wash it white, and keep the loaf where it is. A finger and a half is the table. I will not let a precept stretch the bread.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The bread is not the precept. The precept is the colour. Eat, both of you. Sunday is when it is read. Tonight it is only known.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Known, and washed. I can do the washing.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And I can write it down without making the loaf into a sermon. The table has said its measure.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Say it as I said it, if you say it. A finger and a half. A penny. Blue is vanity dyed, and the girl has leave.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Leave, and one band. I will not buy another.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No one is buying. The thimble is already gone to Stratford, and this paper is not a purchase.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then leave Stratford out of my supper. Pass the salt. The clerk did his office and went. We will do ours.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will take the band down after the dishes.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Take it down. Sunday can have the reading. Tonight has the leave, and the loaf as it was this morning.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will remember the loaf. I am only washing a band.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: This morning and tonight are the same loaf. Remember that when you go upstairs to your book.
